title: Keeper of the Hyenas: A Night in Harar — የጅቦቹ ጠባቂ፡ አንድ ምሽት በሐረር
style_block: Nocturnal atmosphere just outside the ancient weathered coral-stone walls of Harar Jugol, warm amber lantern light and soft cool moonlight against deep indigo night shadows, traditional Harari embroidered tunic and wrapped cotton headcloth, documentary realism, subtle 35mm film grain, centered subject framing safe for both 9:16 and 16:9, no embedded text.

character_ref.prompt: Fictional seasoned Harari elder hyena keeper Umar wearing a traditional embroidered Harari tunic and wrapped cotton headcloth, holding an oil lantern beside a woven straw meat basket, next to young Ethiopian man Dawit in a warm dark jacket, standing outside ancient Harar Jugol coral-stone walls at night, warm lantern glow and cool moonlight, centered composition, documentary realism.

music.caption: Atmospheric nocturnal Ethiopian acoustic score, deep resonant krar bass plucks, subtle traditional Harari percussive pulse, and haunting washint flute notes, building from quiet night tension to grounded reverence and peace, spacious under Amharic narration, no vocals

shots.shot_reason: Establish the nocturnal setting outside Harar Jugol's ancient walls, elder keeper Umar's calm authority, and Dawit's initial tension as glowing eyes appear in the dark. Locks blocking: Umar left, Dawit right, lantern and basket between them.
shots.visual_prompt: Wide centered nocturnal shot just outside the ancient weathered coral-stone wall and arched gate of Harar Jugol, seasoned Harari elder keeper Umar in traditional embroidered tunic and wrapped cotton headcloth standing calmly on the left beside a glowing amber lantern and woven straw basket, young man Dawit in a dark jacket standing slightly tense on the right, faint pairs of glowing hyena eyes visible in the moonlit brush beyond, key subjects inside the central safe frame.
shots.camera_motion: Gentle slow push-in toward the lantern-lit pair as night mist drifts softly.
shots.narration_text: የሐረር ጀጎል ጥንታዊ ግንብ ሲጨልም፣ የሌሊቱ ጸጥታ በጅቦቹ ድምፅ ይሰበራል።
shots.subtitle_en:
As dusk dims Harar Jugol's walls,
the night breaks with hyena calls.
shots.music_cue: Low resonant krar drone and distant night wind enter under dark atmosphere.

shots.shot_reason: Show the traditional woven straw basket of meat scraps and the short wooden feeding stick, grounding the ritual in real Harari practice rather than spectacle.
shots.visual_prompt: Centered close-up of elder keeper Umar's weathered hands preparing pieces of raw meat on a smooth short wooden feeding stick beside a traditional woven straw basket, illuminated by warm flickering amber lantern light against the textured stone ground outside Harar Jugol, shallow depth of field.
shots.camera_motion: Slow steady push-in over the keeper's steady hands and woven basket.
shots.narration_text: ለዘመናት በዘለቀው የሐረር ወግ፣ ፍርሃት በመተማመን ይተካል።
shots.subtitle_en:
In this old Harari tradition,
fear slowly yields to trust.
shots.music_cue: Subtle hand-drum pulse enters quietly beneath the lantern glow.

shots.shot_reason: Deliver the keeper's central heritage wisdom on mutual peace and respect between Harar's people and the hyenas.
shots.visual_prompt: Centered medium close-up of seasoned Harari elder Umar in his traditional tunic and wrapped cotton headcloth, standing on the left in warm golden lantern light, calling softly into the night toward the shadows on the right with a calm, fearless expression, ancient coral-stone wall behind him.
shots.camera_motion: Very slow gentle push-in on Umar's serene, focused face.
shots.narration_text: ጠባቂውም በስማቸው እየጠራ፣ ሰላምን ስትሰጥ ሰላምን ታገኛለህ፣ ተፈጥሮ ክብርን ታውቃለች አለኝ።
shots.subtitle_en:
Calling them softly, the keeper said:
'Give peace, and nature knows respect.'
shots.music_cue: Soft haunting washint flute phrase answers gently.

shots.shot_reason: Show the peaceful feeding interaction—the hyena approaching calmly in lantern light without aggression, proving the keeper's words.
shots.visual_prompt: Centered medium shot in warm amber lantern light and cool blue moonlight: a large spotted hyena steps calmly out of the night shadows and gently takes a piece of meat offered from the short wooden stick held steadily by elder keeper Umar, calm non-aggressive posture, dusty earth and Harar stone wall in soft focus.
shots.camera_motion: Locked-off camera holding cleanly on the calm, respectful exchange.
shots.narration_text: ጅቦቹም በተራቸው ቀርበው ሲበሉ፣ የዱር አውሬ ሳይሆን የከተማዋ ጎረቤቶች ይመስላሉ።
shots.subtitle_en:
Stepping in calmly to feed, they feel
less like beasts than city neighbors.
shots.music_cue: Plucked krar melody carries steady, grounded calm.

shots.shot_reason: Mark Dawit's internal turning point: letting go of fear, stepping forward, and accepting the wooden feeding stick.
shots.visual_prompt: Centered medium close-up of young man Dawit in his dark jacket on the right, watching the peaceful feeding in warm amber lantern light, his tense shoulders relaxing into quiet awe as he takes a steady step forward and accepts the short wooden feeding stick from elder Umar's hand.
shots.camera_motion: Slow steady push-in as Dawit's expression shifts from hesitation to quiet courage.
shots.narration_text: ልቤ ቢመታም ፍርሃቴን ተውኩት፤ በትዕግሥት ወደፊት ተራመድኩ።
shots.subtitle_en:
Though my heart raced, I left fear
behind and stepped forward patiently.
shots.music_cue: Harmonic shift softens from minor tension into warm resonance.

shots.shot_reason: Hold a wordless emotional pause showing elder Umar's quiet nod of approval and trust.
shots.visual_prompt: Centered close-up of elder keeper Umar in his wrapped cotton headcloth turning toward Dawit on the right, giving a slow, reassuring nod and a warm, proud smile in the golden glow of the lantern, night shadows softly blurred behind him.
shots.camera_motion: Locked-off camera, subtle nod and flickering lantern light.
shots.music_cue: No narration; warm krar and washint melody swells gently in the silence.

shots.shot_reason: Demonstrate Dawit's transformation in action: calmly offering food to a hyena under Umar's steady presence.
shots.visual_prompt: Centered medium shot of young man Dawit kneeling steadily in the lantern light on the right while elder Umar stands calmly beside him on the left, Dawit holding the short wooden stick out calmly as a spotted hyena approaches gently and takes the offering in peace, warm amber glow against the dark Harar night.
shots.camera_motion: Gentle slow side drift keeping Dawit, Umar, and the hyena inside the central safe frame.
shots.narration_text: በእርጋታ ስቀርብ፣ ሌሊቱ አስፈሪ መሆኑ ቀርቶ የአብሮነት ምስክር ሆነ።
shots.subtitle_en:
When I came in stillness, the dark
became a witness to coexistence.
shots.music_cue: Main acoustic theme lifts warmly as trust is shared.

shots.shot_reason: Resolve the film by mirroring Shot 01's wide composition outside Harar Jugol's walls in peaceful harmony as hyenas retreat into the moonlit night.
shots.visual_prompt: Wide centered nocturnal shot mirroring the opening frame outside the ancient coral-stone wall of Harar Jugol: elder keeper Umar on the left and young man Dawit on the right standing side by side in calm camaraderie beside the glowing amber lantern and woven basket, spotted hyenas walking peacefully back into the moonlit hills beyond, warm lantern glow under a starry Ethiopian night sky.
shots.camera_motion: Slow gentle pull-back revealing the ancient silhouette of Harar Jugol under moonlight.
shots.narration_text: የሐረር ጥበብ ይህ ነው፤ ሰውና ተፈጥሮ በክብር ሲተያዩ፣ ጨለማው እንኳ ሰላምን ያውጃል።
shots.subtitle_en:
This is Harar's wisdom: when people
and nature meet in respect, peace wins.
shots.music_cue: Final resonant krar chord rings warmly and fades cleanly into night ambiance.
